<nowiki />
|translation='''Title:''' Luke? Where are you, Luke!

'''Card text:''' Deploy on any Tatooine location card. Choose one Rebel as a target. The target's power and forfeit are reduced by 1, or by 3 if the target is Luke. If its forfeit becomes 0 or less, the card is lost. This card is canceled when the target reaches its location.

'''Lore:''' “All right, I'm coming now, Aunt Beru.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese permits deployment on a Tatooine location card; the English says a Tatooine site. The Japanese says the target is lost if its forfeit becomes zero or less; the English says it is lost if its forfeit reaches zero.
